lectures.title: Package Management with Snap: Dealing with Self-Contained Applications

to be sure with those dependencies that everything works properly.
Um, one wrong dependency can be extremely problematic and can cause apt to fail or to be unable to
resolve it.

SNAP is another package format that tries to solve this and it also tries to ensure that packages are
more compatible between different Linux distributions, which is not the case as of now.
SNAP solves all of this.
